Definition: Banana, the name of four Israelite
BiblicalUsage: Baana or Baanah = "in the affliction"; 1) the son of Ahilud, Solomon's commissariat officer in Jezreel and the north of the Jordan valley; 2) another of Solomon's officers; 3) father of Zadok who assisted in rebuilding the wall of Jerusalem under Nehemiah
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
